formulas.flip_sub_prefix: reverse(BA - DC), preserving a negative sign as an operator prefix
formulas.flip_sub_suffix: reverse(DC - BA), appending the operator for a negative result
formulas.flip_absdiff_suffix: reverse(|BA - DC|) followed by the operator

global_constraints: All non-join rules in one prompt use either normal or flipped operand family.
At most one non-join rule from each semantic group: sub_or_mod_like, add_like, mul_like.
Join and reverse-join are the join_like exception and can coexist with the other groups.
A query operator absent from examples is Guess; it is admitted only when all valid assignments give one query output.
